use_case_summary: Primary objective: replace aging rules bot with LLM-first support assistant that handles multi-turn sessions, slot-filling, and doc retrieval. Need sub-200ms p95 for chat path and seamless streaming for agent UI. Also heavy reranking for search results during conversation.
technical_notes: POC shows steady throughput but P95 too high due to per-request kernel fallback and suboptimal streaming windowing. Short-turn conversations hurt prefix caching — high variance in sequence length. Proposed mitigation: dedicated pool with optimized 8-bit quantized model and aggressive packing; customer says they'd prefer proven streaming experience vs experimental optimizations.
sales_notes: Customer enthusiastic about features, but performance is the gating factor. Quote: 'If streaming still stutters, agents will reject it.' Pricing acceptable if we demonstrate p95 improvement. No strong internal champion beyond Dir. of Product (shadowed by infra lead who is conservative).
final_status_summary: Stalled / effectively closed-lost: customer leaned toward competitor (ZephyrAI) after side-by-side demo showed lower p95 and cleaner streaming. Budget hold and lack of internal champion reduced urgency. Marking as churn risk; keep on 3-month nurture cadence.
